Hi Elena —

Hope you had a good weekend. We're getting ahead of Wavefront's renewal in September and I wanted to start with a short usage / performance check so we can recommend the right renewal structure (term vs commit, and any capacity buffers). Can you confirm the Q2 token volume trends and whether you expect the next 3 months to match, accelerate, or decelerate?

If helpful, can you share: 1) the export of token usage by route (chat/generate/embeddings) for Apr–Jun (CSV is perfect), and 2) any notes on latency or error spikes you saw (timestamps helpful). I can pull our serving-side latency summary as well.

Goal: produce a one-page scorecard (usage, cost-to-serve, latency percentiles, and an ROI line showing cost/unit vs predicted value) so we come to renewal conversations with concrete options.

Attached is a small template to populate (Wavefront_usage_Q2_2026.csv) — you can drop it back on this thread or share to the Drive link below.

Next steps: if you can send the CSV by EOD Thu (18th), Marissa and I will build the scorecard and propose two paths (1. 12-month commit with 15% base discount + burst credits; 2. 6-month renewal with capacity banding + performance SLA).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Hi Elena / Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for the data and patience while we modeled a few scenarios. Attached are three artifacts: 1) Wavefront_usage_Q2_2026.csv (filled), 2) inference_latency_report_Q2.pdf (serving-side P50/P95/P99 and deploy correlation), and 3) Wavefront_renewal_options_v2.xlsx (financials and term comparison). Quick summary below.

Scorecard (high level):
- Q2 token volume: 1.9B tokens (+32% QoQ)
- Cost-to-serve (current): $0.0018 per token average (across routes)
- Chat route P95 (serving-side): 140ms (baseline excluding May 14 spike)
- Peak burst days: two events in May where chat request rate hit ~3x baseline for ~6 hours

ROI and recommendation:
Option A — 12mo commit (recommended):
- Commit: 2.2B tokens/yr (15% discount on list, includes 20% burst credit pool)
- Estimated blended price: $0.00155/token
- Benefit: predictable unit cost, simpler procurement, we include proactive latency monitoring and quarterly review

Option B — 6mo flexible:
- Commit: 1.1B tokens (lower discount, higher per-token), automatic regional surge routing for bursts
- Estimated blended price: $0.00178/token
- Benefit: lower near-term commitment, more flexibility if growth slows

Additional notes: we modeled a quantization/ops knob that could reduce cost by ~8% on the embedding-heavy routes without impacting chat quality. If Wavefront is comfortable with a staged rollout of that optimization, we can bake it into Option A to improve margin.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement to confirm preferred term and internal PO timeline (Procurement, can you share target approval date?).
2) If Option A is preferred, we'll prepare a draft SOW/addendum and target signature by Sep 10 to avoid any service disruption.
3) Schedule a 30-min call with Tech Ops + Product to walk the latency report and the proposed monitoring play (I can host).

Elena — are you available Wed 7 Sep or Thu 8 Sep for a quick 30-min walkthrough?

Thanks — will follow up with a DocuSign link once we have the selected option.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
